goal: Fix account deletion end-to-end for every provider: truthful durable progress and completion, idempotent retries, fair worker claiming, retained cleanup network, regression and browser fault acceptance.
context: Canonical HEAD7f5d7dc, runtime1eb7acd, migration157. User recording shows Upcloud11 with zero tracked servers, attempts3, waiting for in-flight work. Live read confirms account now purged and no active deletion jobs; do not claim it is still stuck. Root observed UX issue: fixed2min settle +60s retry is not explained or timed, generic accepted toast no completion, poll races/reset scroll. Verified source defects: repeat DELETE after purge404; worker selects oldest job BEFORE advisory-lock so locked head starves others and misses due recheck; canceled context prevents recording timeout; proxy keeper stops on last droplet even while deletion job still needs final provider/SSH checks. Fix these shared paths without reducing required provider-absence safety or deleting credentials prematurely. Keep fixed2min safety settle, schedule exactly boundary; persisted next_attempt and structured progress incl pending operations/keys, retry time and local purge eligibility. UI must distinguish queued/settling/cleanup/blocked and completion, preserve position, handle lost response and duplicate clicks. Explicit local-only purge remains acknowledged separate path, never automatic. Protect unrelated accounts, scoped gates, config/client/residential settings. Fake providers and isolated BULK_TEST database only for tests. No live cloud creates/deletes just for testing; no pending real account jobs currently to expedite. Use AI OS and source-grounded OpenAI review; keep test outputs. Tests race/fault, PostgreSQL all3provider identities, lock head, timeout, duplicate, transaction rollback, mobile/desktop browser completion. Build disk tmp, deploy exact clean source with backup rollback. No transport experiments.
commit_message: fix(accounts): make durable deletion progress reliable across providers
